seo.title: Tumbled Limestone Pavers & Stone Flooring
seo.description: Eco Outdoor provides the best in Tumbled Limestone pavers and flooring for your project. Find resources, request a sample or contact a rep today.

content.value: This range of limestone flooring is achieved by tumbling the stone in a machine with materials such as sand or pebbles. The tumbling process amplifies the stone’s natural imperfections and colour variations, while at the same time smooths and rounds the edges, giving it a softer appearance and a more paired back antique look.
